rules.prepare: # The options of Debian's rules, without the tests. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" cmake -G Ninja \ -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-gcc" \ -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ -DCMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR=lib \ -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=None \ -DCMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RPATH=ON \ -DCMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE=ON \ -DCARES_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \ -DCARES_BUILD_TOOLS=OFF \ -DCARES_SHARED=ON \ -DCARES_STATIC=ON \ -DCARES_SYMBOL_HIDING=ON \ "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
